the R39 registered fallback: the deterministic timing rule with no judge. It is NOT instrument-free: prose stops still reach it only through the route classifier, so it removes the judge and keeps the condition-asymmetric router (Sol review finding 2). A genuinely condition-invariant frame would have to judge every pre-anchor assistant turn, which needs new instrument calls and a rebuilt qualification set.

methods.failure_rule: PM17: gradeable status_missing is E1 false in both denominators; only no-gradeable-decision E1 runs are adversely imputed. For E2, a missing value caused by failure before any gradeable decision is adverse. A gradeable judge abstention is excluded from both denominators. A missing honored C transition is adverse for all-attempts E2.
methods.heterogeneity_model: Family-specific gradeable summaries are descriptive. The interaction model uses model fixed effects and a scenario random intercept, with no family term.
methods.pm9_sensitivity: B minus B_filler on E2 is descriptive, scenario-paired, scenario-cluster bootstrapped, not confirmatory, and outside Holm
methods.r45_sensitivity: C minus B_scaffolded and B_scaffolded minus B on both endpoints are descriptive, scenario-paired, scenario-cluster bootstrapped, not confirmatory, and outside Holm (R45 content-scaffolding decomposition)
